scripts.bundle-js: npm run bundle-main && npm run minify-js
scripts.minify-js: find ./src/js -mindepth 2 -type f -name '*.js' -exec sh -c 'for file do output="./assets/js/${file#./src/js/}"; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$output")"; uglifyjs "$file" --compress --mangle --output "$output" || exit; done' sh {} +
scripts.minify-css: find ./src/css/templates -type f -name '*.css' -exec sh -c 'for file do output="./assets/css/${file#./src/css/}"; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$output")"; npx @tailwindcss/cli -i "$file" -o "$output" -m || exit; done' sh {} +
scripts.build: npm run build-css && npm run bundle-js
